changes: Added the done_prepare readiness command, command aliases/policy/registry wiring, process-fact registration, focused smoke coverage, and decision-doc alignment for metadata auto-commit behavior.
usage: Run node packages/main/dist/cli.js done_prepare {"storyId":"B-xxxx"} from a TEST story worktree; after merge/rebuild the public command is lattice done_prepare or lattice done prepare.
expectedOutcome: For a DONE-ready TEST story, the command prints DONE prepare: PASS and one story_advance DONE command; when gates are missing it prints DONE prepare: BLOCKED with blockedAt, commands, and next action.
actualTranscript: Real-machine run with the worktree CLI on B-fb36 printed DONE prepare: BLOCKED at doneClosure, listing delivery-check, review escalation, review assurance, branch sync, and summary blockers; no Authority or production completion was claimed.
outcomeDiff: No product-behavior mismatch: B-fb36 itself was not DONE-ready, so the observed BLOCKED output matched the fail-closed expectation.
limitations: Global lattice binary did not know done_prepare until this story is merged and rebuilt; verification used node packages/main/dist/cli.js from the story worktree.
pitfalls: Reviewer findings required extra fixes for alias normalization, cli-engine/process-fact mirrors, dryRun planned-mutation coverage, auto-commit metadata blocking, and doc alignment; use done_prepare as local readiness only, not Authority completion.
